newsitem.title: INDIA: India's IRFC 14.25 pct bond oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: India's IRFC 14.25 pct bond oversubscribed.

text.p: The Indian Railway Finance Corporation's (IRFC) 14.25 percent taxable bond issue for 2.5 billion rupees ($69.8 million) was heavily oversubscribed, the government said on Wednesday.
It said in a statement that with this offering, which closed on Wednesday, IRFC's targeted sum of nine billion rupees for taxable bonds for 1997/98 would be fully raised.
It said IRFC's 10.5 percent tax-free bond issue for one billion rupees in April/May raised 3.5 billion.

"As a matter of fact, IRFC (is) poised to complete a major part of its resource mobilisation target of 21.5 billion rupees for 1997/98 by the end of July 1997, as it is also going for roadshows of External Commercial Borrowings of $150 million," it said.

By July, IRFC will have raised approximately 17.5 billion rupees in 1997/98, and the remainder of four billion rupees will be raised in the next few months through tax free bonds, it said. The Finance Ministry has approved the bonds.
